fusions.name: Borrowed Voice
fusions.desc: Throws a mimicked cry into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 30% chance of leaving it [Stalled] for 4 seconds, so its abilities come back slower.

fusions.name: Magpie's Lift
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles onto the target with a weapon strike that deals 12 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and leaves it [Damped] for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lost Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and enemies notice you far later. You move 22% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Cheap Trick
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
